title: Elasticsearch Small Examples
description: Use these small Elasticsearch examples with the tools described in each lesson. Read the expected result before you try a change.

examples.title: Meet an index and document
examples.description: An index is a group of searchable documents.
examples.output: The practice index receives document 1. The response reports whether it was created or updated.

examples.title: Choose field mappings first
examples.description: A mapping tells Elasticsearch how a field should be searched.
examples.output: A new empty practice index is created with explicit field types.

examples.title: Index a known sample
examples.description: Indexing stores a document so search can use its fields.
examples.output: The response waits until the new sample can be found by search.

examples.title: Read one document by id
examples.description: The document get API reads a specific id.
examples.output: The response includes found:true and the stored source for Moon Trip when the document exists.

examples.title: Search analysed words
examples.description: A match query searches text using the field's analyser.
examples.output: The Moon Trip sample matches the search word moon.

examples.title: Filter an exact category
examples.description: A term filter checks an exact indexed value.
examples.output: Only documents whose keyword kind is story are selected.

examples.title: Filter a numeric range
examples.description: A range query selects numbers between bounds.

examples.title: Combine search and a filter
examples.description: A bool query can combine word search with exact conditions.
examples.output: The sample must match the title search and also have kind story.

examples.title: Ask for a small ordered result
examples.description: A search request can limit its hit count and sort by a field.
examples.output: At most two shortest sample documents are returned with title and pages in their source.

examples.title: Count categories with an aggregation
examples.output: The response contains category buckets with document counts, without ordinary search hits.

examples.title: Update one field
examples.description: The update API can change selected fields of an existing document.
examples.output: Document 1 keeps its other fields and changes pages to 64.

examples.title: Delete only the sample record
examples.description: The delete API removes one document by its id.
examples.output: The named sample document is removed. A later get reports it missing.
